# Nadeem Dev Apps

> Nadeem Dev Apps builds small, local-first apps. The website is a portfolio,
> marketing, and product site. Products live as sub-pages.

- [Home](https://nadeemdevapps.github.io/my-web/)
- [Tsumly](https://nadeemdevapps.github.io/my-web/products/tsumly/): local-first personal expense and loan ledger. "Every amount adds up." Smart multi-loan repayment split, optional Google Drive backup.
- [Kaizenly](https://nadeemdevapps.github.io/my-web/products/kaizenly/): a strict, local-first focus guard, built from scratch.

## Pages

- [Home](https://nadeemdevapps.github.io/my-web/)
- [Products](https://nadeemdevapps.github.io/my-web/products/)
- [Tsumly](https://nadeemdevapps.github.io/my-web/products/tsumly/)
- [Kaizenly](https://nadeemdevapps.github.io/my-web/products/kaizenly/)
- [About](https://nadeemdevapps.github.io/my-web/about/)
- [Contact](https://nadeemdevapps.github.io/my-web/contact/)

## Notes

- The site is a static Astro site. Design tokens live in DESIGN.md in the repo root.
- About, Contact, Privacy, and Terms pages are planned; the Privacy page will
  carry the privacy-policy URL used by the Tsumly app's Google OAuth setup.
